gloss: to wake up, to get up

definitions.gloss: to wake up, to get up
definitions.explanation: Used when someone wakes from sleep and gets out of bed. Can also mean to happen or occur (for events).
Used for events, incidents, or phenomena that take place. Common in news and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{起|お}きています⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{起|お}きました。
⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{起|お}きて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up late on Sundays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{起|お}きた⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らせて→知らせる：01208_shiraseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let me know immediately when a problem occurs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}→目覚まし時計：03159_mezamashidokei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I always wake up at 6 o'clock even without an alarm clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{起|お}きたら、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If an earthquake happens, get under your desk immediately.
Strange things often happen when he's not around.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：noentry⟧ (intransitive). Pair: ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (transitive, to wake someone up). Pattern: Xが{起|お}きる.

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {起|お}きている = 'is awake' (not 'is waking up'). This is important: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{起|お}きている means 'still awake.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{起|お}きる (wake up early)
・〜⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{起|お}きる (wake up at ~ o'clock)
・⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{起|お}きる (an accident occurs - sense 2)
・{起|お}きていますか (are you awake?)

Opposite: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep/go to bed).
